title: fix `system connection add` running inside rootless user namespace
body:
native SSH must use the caller's SSH configuration, keys, and `known_hosts`. excluding `connection` in `can_use_shortcut` prevents the early namespace join (including interleaving flags).

SSH stderr propagation still remains an issue which I believe should be handled under `podman-container-tools/container-libs`.

There is a tradeoff (which is reasonable in my opinion) - any argument exactly equal to "connection" disables the early optimization, including an unrelated option value. Commands needing the namespace retain their normal Go setup path. I checked that fallback with `podman unshare`.

Added five regression tests that cover different flag positions, and both flag-value syntaxes, and verify that native SSH retains the caller's UID and user namespace.

`make validatepr` ran successfully

Partially addresses:  #30125
